install: mkdir -p "$HOME/.npm-global" && npm config set prefix "$HOME/.npm-global" && export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH" && (touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true) && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc") && (command -v firebase >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit firebase-tools) && firebase --version && for f in public/assets/js/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
